cells.gaps: No source found names a government cloud or data centre in service that public bodies must use: the National Cloud Data Center was still under construction in November 2026.
cells.note: The innovation minister reiterated in November 2026 existing federal directives for public institutions to move off standalone server rooms onto shared national infrastructure, a hosting policy in force. The national cloud data centre meant to host them was still being built, so not stage 4.
